body:
Progress 2026-10-07: built and tested (break-proven, 96-100% coverage).
- New package contrib/video/ffmpeg: a shared bounded runner.
- video: Transcode/TranscodeProcessor (VD-03) and Storyboard+WebVTT (VD-05).
- New module contrib/audio: Probe, Inspect, Waveform, Opus/AAC Transcode and TranscodeProcessor, records plugin (VD-06/07/08).
- New module contrib/videoplatform: records plugin, table fs_video_assets, webhook handler, mux and cfstream adapters tested against in-process fakes (VD-04, VD-09).
- Docs: plugins/video.md (3 sections), plugins/audio.md, module READMEs.
Left:
- Run the engines (Postgres/MySQL) for fs_video_assets.
- Add contrib/videoplatform to MODULES.
- Add docs/README.md and root README rows (owned by others).
- Review not yet run.
- No example under examples/.
- Real Mux/Cloudflare accounts not exercised.
